definitions.explanation: With deep sincerity and urgency. Used to express heartfelt wishes, prayers, or requests.

examples.japanese: {切|せつ}に⟦{願|ねが}っています→願う：02387_negau⟧。
⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|せつ}に⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|せつ}に⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I humbly and earnestly ask for everyone's cooperation.

notes:
Adverbial form of {切|せつ} (keen, acute). A formal, literary expression conveying deep sincerity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|せつ}に⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧ (to earnestly wish)
- {切|せつ}に⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (to earnestly pray)
- {切|せつ}に⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧ (to earnestly desire)
- {切|せつ}に⟦お{願|ねが}いする→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧ (to sincerely request)
- {切|せつ}に⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel keenly)

USAGE:
{切|せつ}に is more formal and literary than simply using ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ or ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧. It appears frequently in formal speeches, written appeals, and polite requests. It pairs naturally with verbs of wishing, praying, and requesting.
